confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Peru's Sacred Valley and Cusco-area tourist pricing, with July high-season demand assumed. Restaurant anchors are moderately confident; accommodation and drink anchors are less certain and are bounded estimates. No live listings or booking pages were inspected. FX: the 0.6947 figure came from a third-party page (ozfinancehub) that attributes it to the RBA daily table for 2026-10-16. The rba.gov.au page was not opened in this session, so the figure should be verified against the RBA F11.1 table before official use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against Cusco and other Sacred Valley tourist towns, adjusted upward for Ollantaytambo's role as the main rail and bus gateway to Machu Picchu, which raises demand for hostels and mid-range hotels in July.
